notes.title: Jun 16 Update
notes.content:
Implement Save/Load functionality. Can be accessed via:

[olist]
[*] Main Menu - Load, New
[*] In-Game Pause Menu - Save, Load, New, Delete
[/olist]
Currently, the world meta-state, dialogue and quest states, and inventory states are saved. Future versions may included checkpoints.

notes.title: Update Notes for June 5
